name: ORQEVIA

experience.purpose: Help visitors understand the work, inspect an illustrative decision and begin a relevant conversation with Andrew.
experience.demo: Curated illustrative scenarios; no model inference, live task execution or private memory.
experience.integration: Public navigation and project-specific enquiry context. Domain data remains in its owning system.

truth_rules: ABEX is the intended ORQEVIA runtime host; deployment requires an independently verified native-host receipt.
Dell, PWA and voice are authenticated clients. Historical Dell evidence is not current ABEX evidence.
21 registered logical agents does not imply 21 simultaneous inference workers.
Public demonstrations cannot imply live runtime verification, measured business outcomes or automated physical control.
No public links to loopback controls or owner-only enquiry records.
